entries.title: Small Business Core (the books)
entries.creator: Timmy Gack
entries.ai_assist: Claude (Anthropic, Opus 5.5): first-principles map, shared CSV schema, books.py, tests
entries.notes: Foundation for small-business cells: FIRST-PRINCIPLES.md maps the business loop (offer > customer > quote > schedule > work > invoice > paid > books > learn) as a build queue; schema.json defines one shared set of CSV books; books.py init/check/status/ar. ar export feeds invoice-followup (parent). Router returned BUILD. No upstream code copied. uses=0: no real-world use yet.

entries.title: Small Business Core v0.2: callable tools
entries.creator: Timmy Gack
entries.ai_assist: Claude (Anthropic, Opus 5.5): tools.py, tools.json contract, validated writes, git versioning, tests
entries.notes: 12 callable tools declared in tools.json (contract v1) so any AI can run the books by conversation: status, lookups, add customer/offer/job, update job, invoice, record payment, history, undo. Fuzzy references; asks when ambiguous. Every write validated against the full books before saving; each save is a git commit (timestamped history + non-destructive undo). uses=0.

entries.title: Invoice follow-up v0.2: callable tool on the shared books
entries.creator: Timmy Gack
entries.notes: Adds draft_payment_reminders, which reads the shared books directly. Drafts only. uses=0.

entries.title: Glean tool server (MCP): run your business by talking to any AI
entries.creator: Timmy Gack
entries.ai_assist: Claude (Anthropic, Opus 5.5): server design, stdlib implementation, end-to-end test, docs
entries.notes: Stdlib stdio MCP server. Discovers every cells/*/tools.json (contract v1) so each new cell is callable on merge with no server change. Adds what_can_you_do, search_cells (commons-catalog), note_missing_capability (wishlist = build queue). Writes only to the owner's local books via cell tools. Implements the open Model Context Protocol; no upstream code copied. Also adds cells/small-business-core/JOBS.md (job-function map). uses=0.

entries.title: Glean Commons dashboard (built from the repo)
entries.creator: Timmy Gack
entries.ai_assist: Claude (Anthropic, Opus 5.5): generator, page, CI wiring
entries.notes: scripts/build_dashboard.py turns commons.json, the ledger, every cells/*/tools.json and JOBS.md into dashboard/data/*.csv, data.json and a self-contained dashboard/index.html (no dependencies; opens anywhere; GitHub Pages ready). Deterministic; CI rebuilds it and fails if stale, so the dashboard changes with every merge. Shows job coverage, contribution chain, tools, integrity, registry. uses=0.

entries.title: Parallel builds without ledger forks, plus OpenTimestamps anchors
entries.creator: Timmy Gack
entries.ai_assist: Cursor Agent: pending-entry ledger, fold workflow, validate_pending, OpenTimestamps anchoring (PR #7)
entries.notes: PR #7. Contributions add ledger/pending/<id>.json instead of editing the chain; after merge, fold-ledger.yml appends them in order with add_entry.py and rebuilds catalog and dashboard, so many agents can build in parallel without forking the ledger. anchor-timestamps.yml stamps ledger tip + commit with OpenTimestamps (Bitcoin). Credited retroactively by Claude at the maintainer's request; the work and code are the Cursor Agent's.

entries.title: Every contribution carries its credit (CI check)
entries.creator: Timmy Gack
entries.ai_assist: Claude (Anthropic, Opus 5.5): check_credit.py, tests, CI step, AGENTS.md rule
entries.notes: Root-cause fix for uncredited work (PR #7 merged with no ledger entry). CI now fails a PR that changes contribution paths without adding ledger/pending/<id>.json; docs and generated files exempt; maintainer 'no-credit' label for trivial fixes. Implements whitepaper sec 4.3 and 3.4 as a gate, not a guideline.
